positions.commentary: The speaker maintains a positive view on Wells Fargo despite recent scandals, noting the scope of direct damage was manageable and competitors had worse deficiencies.

thesis: The episode argues for a bullish stance on Wells Fargo (WFC), suggesting that the direct damage from recent scandals was manageable and that the bank's deficiencies were less severe than those of its competitors.
